app.description: Your kind conscience for building habits.

onboarding.title: First steps
onboarding.repeatHelp: Choose your language again, create an identity and a habit, and see how to install Pepita. Nothing gets deleted.

language.title: Hi! I'm Pepita. Which language shall we use?
language.help: I'm suggesting your browser's language; you can change it any time. No accounts: everything stays on this device.
language.backup: Have a backup? Restore it in Settings

identity.title: Who do you want to be?
identity.help: Write it as a sentence: “I am a person who…”. Each habit will be a vote for that person.

log.title: Shall we do it now?
log.help: Do your minimum version and tap it: that's your first vote. If you can't right now, that's fine.

install.title: Keep Pepita close
install.help: Installed on your home screen, it opens instantly and takes better care of your data.
install.menu: If your browser allows it, add it to your home screen from its menu.
install.alreadyInstalled: You already have Pepita installed. Great!

ios.title: How to install it on your iPhone or iPad
ios.share: In Safari, tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
ios.add: Choose “Add to Home Screen” and tap “Add”.
ios.open: From now on, open Pepita from its icon.
ios.why: Safari may delete data from websites you haven't opened in a few weeks. Once installed, Pepita keeps it.

today.title: Today
today.empty: Nothing due today. Rest, or add a small habit if you like.
today.notes_one: Pepita has a note for you
today.votesTotal_one: vote for the person you want to be
today.votesTotal_other: votes for the person you want to be

identities.title: Identities
identities.intro: Every time you do a habit, you cast a vote for who you want to be.
identities.help: Write it as a sentence: “I am someone who…”.
identities.archivedHelp: They keep their habits and votes. Their habits stay out of Today until you bring them back.
identities.forHabit: Who are you voting for with this habit?
identities.filterEmpty: No habits for this identity today. You can add one if you like.

frequency.title: How often?
frequency.times_per_period: A few times a day, week or month

settings.title: Settings
settings.dayCutoffHelp: Anything you do before {{time}} counts for the day before, so a late night still counts.

backups.title: Backups of your data
backups.intro: Everything lives only on this device. A backup now and then keeps it safe.
backups.none: You haven't made a backup yet.
backups.importHelp: Choose a Pepita JSON file. I'll ask before changing anything.
backups.exported: Backup saved. Your data is safe.
backups.imported: Done: your data has been restored.
backups.confirmTitle: Replace your data with this backup?
backups.confirmText: The backup has {{habits}} and {{logs}}. It will replace everything currently on this device.
backups.unchanged: Your data is just as it was.

error.not_json: This file doesn't look like a Pepita backup.
error.not_pepita: This file doesn't look like a Pepita backup.
error.newer_version: This backup comes from a newer version of Pepita. Update the app and try again.
error.invalid: This backup is damaged and can't be used (problem at “{{path}}”).

backups.notice: It's been over a week since your last backup. Shall we save one? It only takes a moment.
backups.persistentYes: Your browser will keep your data even if it runs low on space.
backups.persistentNo: Your browser might delete your data if it runs out of space. Backups keep you covered.
backups.persistentUnavailable: This browser can't be asked for persistent storage. Backups keep you covered.

name.title: What do you want to do?
name.help: Something small and easy to start works best. This is the only must; the rest can wait.

identity.title: Who are you voting for with this habit?
identity.help: Every time you do it, you cast a vote for the person you want to be.

type.title: What kind of habit is it?
type.help: To break a habit, flip the method: make it invisible, unattractive, difficult and unsatisfying.
type.yes_noHelp: You check it off when you do it.
type.quantitativeHelp: At least 20 pages, or at most 2 coffees. You add up what you do.
type.avoidHelp: You only log a slip. Every clean day adds a vote once it closes.

frequency.title: How often?
frequency.help: It doesn’t have to be daily. Pick a pace you can keep.

versions.title: Your minimum and full versions
versions.help: The minimum fits in 2 minutes and counts just like the full one. On hard days, showing up is enough.

intention.title: When and where?
intention.help: Deciding when and where you will do it means starting doesn’t depend on feeling like it.

environment.title: Set up your space
environment.help: Keep what you need in sight. The easier it is to start, the better.
environment.example: For example: leave the book on the pillow

reward.title: Paired reward
reward.help: Pair the habit with something you enjoy and you’ll look forward to it.
reward.example: For example: I only listen to my podcast while walking

cue.title: Which cue will you remove from sight?
cue.help: Make it invisible: what you don’t see barely tempts you.
cue.example: For example: leave the phone outside the bedroom

friction.title: What friction will you add?
friction.help: Make it difficult: the more steps, the less you’ll want to.
friction.example: For example: log out of the app

substitute.title: What will you do instead?
substitute.help: A habit doesn’t just vanish: it helps to have something else at hand.

habit.archiveHelp: Archiving takes it off Today and keeps its history and votes. You can bring it back any time.
habit.deleteText_one: Its check-in and its vote will be deleted too. This can’t be undone. If you just want to set it aside, archive it.
habit.deleteText_other: Its {{count}} check-ins and their votes will be deleted too. This can’t be undone. If you just want to set it aside, archive it.
habit.help: Tap any day to log it, fix it or undo it. Everything updates on its own.
habit.noLogs: Nothing logged. If you forgot, you can log it now.
habit.frequencyHelp: It applies from the current period. Anything already closed still counts with the rule you had then, so your history stays true.

habitDetail.strengthHelp: How settled the habit is. It grows every time you do it, and a single miss barely moves it.
habitDetail.notStarted: It hasn’t started yet. You’ll see it settle in here.
habitDetail.heatmapHelp: The last few weeks: each column is a week, Monday to Sunday.
habitDetail.ratioHelp: The minimum counts too. When the full version comes easily, it may be a good time to raise the bar.
habitDetail.noRatio: Once you complete it, you’ll see here how often it was each version.

archived.title: Archived habits
archived.intro: They rest here with their history. Their votes still count.

pauses.reasonExample: For example: I have a fever
pauses.skipHelp: Skipping adds nothing and takes nothing away: it's a rest with permission.
pauses.skippedNotice: Done, you skipped it. It doesn't count as a miss.
pauses.pausedNotice: Paused until {{date}}. Those days don't count as a miss.
pauses.resumed: Welcome back! It counts again from today.

global.title: Holidays
global.intro: Pause all your habits until a date. Those days don't count as a miss, and the pause ends on its own.
global.active: You're on holiday until {{date}}. Your habits will wait, no rush.
global.ended: Hello again! Your habits count again from today.
global.notice: On holiday until {{date}}. None of this counts as a miss.

recovery.suggestion: Time to come back. The minimum version is enough.
recovery.streakHelp: Counts the periods you completed. A single miss doesn't break it.
recovery.record: What happened? (if you'd like to say)
recovery.recordHelp: No blame: it just helps to understand what the habit needs.

laws.1: I didn't notice it (1st law: make it obvious)
laws.2: I didn't feel like it (2nd law: make it attractive)
laws.3: It was hard (3rd law: make it easy)
laws.4: It didn't feel worth it (4th law: make it satisfying)

identityDetail.noVotes: No votes yet. The first one arrives when you do a habit for this identity.
identityDetail.noHabits: This identity has no habits yet.
identityDetail.notFound: I can't find this identity. Maybe it came from an older backup.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.all: You've reached every milestone. Every vote still counts.
milestones.celebrationIdentity: Look how many times you voted for “{{identity}}”. That person is already you.

quantitative.minTargetHelp: Your minimum version: a small amount that still earns a vote on hard days.

status.pending: Add what you do, even a little
status.within: Going well: your vote comes when the period closes
status.over: Over the limit this time. The next period starts fresh

avoid.relapsed: Slip logged. Tomorrow is another day
avoid.help: It happens to everyone. Logging it helps you see what sets it off.
avoid.recorded: Logged. One slip doesn’t erase how far you’ve come.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.intro: Bring your timed habits to your phone's calendar: it will remind you even when Pepita is closed.
reminders.exportHelp: Habits with a time are included, each with its alarm. Habits that come after another one appear in its description.
reminders.exported: Done. Open the file to add it to your calendar.
reminders.none: You don't have habits with a time yet. Once you give one a time under “When”, it will show up here.
reminders.notifications: Remind me while Pepita is open
reminders.notificationsHelp: I'll nudge you at the time of each habit still left for today. Only works while the app is open.
reminders.blocked: Your browser doesn't let Pepita notify you. If you like, you can allow it in its settings.
reminders.unavailable: This browser doesn't support notifications. The calendar file (.ics) will still work.

diagnosis.notice: What happened with “{{name}}”? Let’s look at it together
diagnosis.title: What happened with “{{name}}”?
diagnosis.intro: Twice in a row without doing it. That’s okay: it’s a clue, not your fault. What weighed most?

tips.1: Make it obvious: tie it to a specific time and place, and you’ll see it coming.
tips.2: Make it attractive: pair it with something you enjoy, or remember who you want to be.
tips.3: Make it easy: make it so small you can’t say no, and set things up beforehand.
tips.4: Make it satisfying: look at how much you’ve added up. And if now isn’t the time, pausing is fine too.

diagnosis.snoozed: We’ll leave it for later. It’s waiting in the habit’s details.
diagnosis.archived: Archived. You can bring it back whenever you like.

progression.title: An idea from Pepita

raise.minimum: “{{name}}” has been steady for weeks. Fancy doing the full version more often?
raise.full: “{{name}}” is part of you now. It might be a good time to raise the goal or the frequency a little.

lower.other: If “{{name}}” has felt uphill, stick to the minimum version for a while. What matters is not letting go.
lower.avoid: If “{{name}}” has felt uphill, let's make temptation harder: add some friction.

progression.confirm: Shall we change it? It applies from the current period; the past stays as it was.
progression.changed: Done. Your habit has its new bar.
progression.dismissed: OK. I won't suggest it again for a few weeks.

review.title: Weekly review
review.intro: Five minutes to look back on your week, kindly.

votes.title: Votes by identity
votes.empty: No votes this time. Any day is a good day to come back.

recovery.title: Getting back on track
recovery.empty: Nothing to get back on track.

failures.title: Why it slipped
failures.empty: You didn’t note any reasons this time.

fields.title: Steps left blank
fields.intro: No rush: here's what you left for later, whenever you feel like it.

note.title: Free note
note.help: What went well? What would you like to change? Just for you.

print.title: Print or save as PDF
print.help: Choose the period and what to include. Whole weeks count, Monday to Sunday.
print.status: Votes and notes for the period. Everything else, as it stands on {{date}}.
